```{r setup}
library(hlebuhanec.0325)
library(sva)
library(limma)
library(DESeq2)
```

```{r}
data("rna_raw")
data("metadata_rna")
metadata_rna <- metadata_rna %>%
    mutate(across(c(Batch, Group, Sex), as.factor))

rna_processed <- rna_raw %>%
    mutate(ID = str_remove(ID, "\\.\\d+$")) %>%
    column_to_rownames("ID") %>%
    select(any_of(pull(metadata_rna, "Patient"))) %>%
   .[rowSums(. >= 10) >= 3, ]

# covar_mod <- model.matrix(~ Age + Sex, data = metadata_rna)
# counts_adj0 <- ComBat_seq(
#   counts    = as.matrix(rna_processed),
#   batch     = metadata_rna$Batch,
#   group     = NULL,
#   covar_mod = covar_mod
# )
counts_adj0 <- rna_processed

couts_norm <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_adj0, colData = metadata_rna, design = ~1) %>%
  estimateSizeFactors() %>%
  vst(blind = TRUE) %>%
  assay()

couts_norm2 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = rna_processed, colData = metadata_rna, design = ~1) %>%
  estimateSizeFactors() %>%
  vst(blind = TRUE) %>%
  assay()

idx <- which(metadata_rna$Group == "PN")
metadata_rna2 <- metadata_rna[idx, ]

counts_adj <- removeBatchEffect(
  couts_norm[, idx],
  batch      = pull(metadata_rna2, "Sex")#,
  # covariates = pull(metadata_rna2, "Age")
)
```

```{r}
library(rstatix)
library(GimmeMyPlot)
plot_pca <- function(m, title) {
  pc <- prcomp(t(m), scale. = FALSE)
  df <- data.frame(pc$x[, 1:2], batch = metadata_rna$Batch,
                   age = metadata_rna$Age, sex = metadata_rna$Sex)
  ggplot(df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = batch, size = age, shape = sex)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    theme_minimal()
}

plot_pca2(couts_norm2[, idx], metadata_rna2)
plot_pca2(counts_adj, metadata_rna2)
```

```{r, eval = TRUE}
counts_adj_pn <- counts_adj
usethis::use_data(counts_adj_pn, overwrite = TRUE)
```
